Code Compliance

The Office of Code Compliance and Community Resources is here to improve the quality of life in Boise’s diverse communities. It incorporates five civil compliance functions to address common issues that arise in urban, residential and commercial settings.

Animal Compliance

Rules and regulations regarding dogs in city parks.

See More
Code and Business License Compliance

Working with Boise's residents to help resolve complaints concerning violations and business license regulations.

See More
Abandoned Vehicles

Rules and regulations surrounding vehicles left within limits of a highway or on private property without consent of the property owner.

See More
Towed and Impounded Vehicles

The Impound Compliance division performs a variety of functions involving the processing, towing and storage of vehicles in violation of Idaho State Code (IC), Title 49.

See More
Parking Compliance

View parking regulations and parking zones within downtown Boise.

See More
Renter Protections

With a goal of improving housing stability and access for Boise residents, the Boise City Council has created several protections for residents who rent their homes in Boise.

See More
Case Lookup Tool

Look up Historical code cases by address, status, and more. Only closed cases will be published to this list.

See More

Report an Issue

Our online system allows you to report code compliance issues, including abandoned vehicles. First time users must create an account. Simply select "Compliance Service Request" under "Request." If you have any questions or issues, please contact us.
